title: Beachfront Breeze
meta_description: 2BR/2BA in PCB with gulf views, resort pool, hot tub, tennis \& walk-in access to St. Andrew's State Park. All these and more at Beachfront Breeze!
description_expanded:
Welcome to Beachfront Breeze, where you can walk straight into the ever popular St. Andrew's State Park on PCB's East End. Take advantage of all of the amenities offered on site like complimentary beach chair services, seasonally heated gulf front pool or hot tub, shuffleboard, picnic tables and tennis. This resort is a local favorite and this unit is a well loved second home on the 10th floor with breathtaking sunset views from the XL balcony.

Rare 2-bedroom and 2-bathroom 10th floor unit has everything you need to enjoy your Panama City Beach vacation. As soon as you enter you can see views of the sparkling Gulf water. You can't beat the views of the large wrap around balcony. If you like to stay in and cook, take advantage of the full-size kitchen and new appliances that are sure to please the chef of the family. A handrail is is installed in one of the showers along with comfort height toilets in both bathrooms for added convenience. Sit on the balcony and watch the sunrise as you drink your morning coffee or have an evening drink as the sun sets. This cozy home and its views are one you will never forget!

Guests will need to check-in at the security gate for passes and property details.
Unit is located on the 10th floor.
Elevators are on the ground level at the center of the building.
Pool and beach access are on the ground floor.
WiFi and door access will be provided in check-in email.

Local hosts nearby available 24/7 for emergencies. Code and instructions sent day of arrival.

Stay like a local in the South Grand Lagoon neighborhood. Only steps from the white sandy beaches and some of the best restaurants and bars in Panama City Beach. Want to ride the emerald waves of PCB or go for a sunset cruise? No problem! Boat rentals, cruises, fishing and dive charters all operate out of local marinas in South Grand Lagoon and only minutes from the Commodore. Walk to Patch's Pub and enjoy a local dive bar with some of the best food around. Walk to St. Andrew's State Park - saving $8 / car load - to get incredible photos, swim in a "kiddie pool" protected inlet area, find shells, and snorkel.
If the weather doesn't cooperate don't worry, there are plenty of rainy day activities \& shopping you can enjoy nearby like miniature golf, museums, Pier Park, Wonder Works and Ripley's Believe It or Not.

The beach, restaurants and retail stores are all walking distance from property. Most indoor and outdoor attractions and shopping centers are only a short drive away.

Golf-cart and bike rentals are available for those that want to get out and explore the area at a slower pace.

Avoid the hassle of carrying chairs and umbrellas to the beach with this unit's complimentary chair service (includes two chairs and umbrella daily from March 1st to October 1. Please note, only starter amenities are provided, you will need to purchase additional toilet paper, trash bags and laundry detergent etc.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure views, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: St. Andrews State Park, Camp Helen State Park, Ms. Newby's and Runaway Island (karaoke), Jimmy Buffett's Margaritaville, Pier Park, Gulf World Marine Park, Water Planet, Little Village Waterfront Shopping Market, SkyWheel, Shipwreck Island Waterpark.

Home Truths:
- Complimentary beach chair setup available for guests.

Parking Details:
- Two vehicles are allowed per unit, but during major Holidays only 1 vehicle is allowed.
- A parking pass is required and HOA charges a fee of $40 for each vehicle.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
Accessibility: Lit path to the guest entrance
